name: StreamFlix
overview: Netflix-style UI, server-verified Google Sign-In & Netflix profiles backed by real Jellyfin users
description: Transforms Jellyfin Web into StreamFlix: a Netflix-style cinema UI with an animated show/film mosaic gate, server-verified Google Sign-In (signed sessions), optional themed Standard/Hybrid Jellyfin login & strict Admin-only fallback, and Netflix 'Who's watching?' profiles mapped to real Jellyfin users.

versions.changelog:
Build for Jellyfin 12.x (.NET 10).

- Flexible authentication: Standard Jellyfin Login, Hybrid Mode, strict IsAdministrator Admin Sign-In fallback & Local LAN bypass
- Admin safety & config persistence: automatic persistent config backup/restore across plugin updates, Sign-out confirmation modal, one-click Test OAuth Config & versioned asset cache-busting
- Home, Top 10 & TV navigation: configurable Top 10 ranking modes with bold #1–#10 badges, configurable Hero Billboard rotation/library filtering, full keyboard & D-pad navigation, and top-right header profile pill clipping fix
